name: Ontario Mills
summary: Indoor outlet mall with over 200 stores as well as a food court,  movie theatres & comedy club.
description: Ontario Mills is a premier indoor outlet shopping destination featuring over 200 stores from top brands offering exceptional value and savings. This expansive shopping center combines outlet retailers with dining and entertainment options, making it one of Southern California's most popular shopping destinations.
demographics: Ontario Mills attracts a diverse, value-conscious demographic spanning middle-income families, young adults, and bargain-seeking shoppers primarily from the Inland Empire region including San Bernardino and Riverside counties. The trade area draws visitors from a 30-mile radius with household incomes ranging from $50,000-$100,000, including a significant Hispanic population and multi-generational family shoppers. Visitors typically engage in destination shopping trips, spending several hours browsing outlet deals, dining at the food court, and enjoying entertainment options, with peak traffic on weekends and holidays when families seek value-oriented retail experiences.
